mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in PAYEMS (> 200k) and decrease in UNRATE (< 5%) signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to impending rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite labor market tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO exceeding 1% signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns following strong INDPRO growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decrease in RSAFS exceeding 5% signals weakening consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite weakening RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A joint low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) and high CPIAUCSL (> 250) signals a monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to impending inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite monetary policy mismatch.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high HOUST rate (> 900k) signals strong housing market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint high PAYEMS (> 150k) and low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a labor market at full employment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite labor market full employment.
